research: FreeCAD DWG-wrapper success semantics and route pinning
type: primary-source review; no peer runtime or native CAD executed
scope: Existing PAR-07/S8 FreeCAD consumer qualification gate
Current FreeCAD DWG converter selection and process-result handling
Cross-project DWG/DXF peer report evidence limits

sources.finding: Current convertToDxf invokes LibreDWG as dwg2dxf <input> -o <output>, waits with communicate(), and treats output-file existence as success without checking child return code. Automatic converter selection can continue to ODA and QCAD; ODA is explicitly asked for ACAD2000 DXF.
The DWG wrapper passes its DXF artifact to importDXF.open, which selects a DXF importer backend and exposes importer statistics.

FreeCAD documents distinct C++ and legacy Python DXF importer subsets: the legacy list includes 3DFACE, the C++ list omits it and skips text/dimensions/attributes inside blocks; embedded ACIS/SAT solids are not currently read.

Open issue reports malformed DWG-to-DXF spline output using NuGet v3.8.0, but the attached/private source drawing and expected control arrays were not inspected. It is a scenario lead, not a local defect or normative rule.

Open issue reports AC1032 output rejected by AutoCAD even when the reporter's MTEXT frame object matched the producer object byte-for-byte, demonstrating that entity-frame equality alone does not establish whole-file acceptance.
Open issue describes DWG/DXF TABLE block-cell value differences using repository samples. Treat as a model/route comparison lead; ODA's versioned DWG content grammar remains authoritative.
LibreDWG is a distinct open-source DWG codec; its advertised version coverage must be evaluated by read/write direction and feature, not as a blanket correctness oracle.
ezdxf's drawing add-on documents no 3D rendering engine and no ACIS rendering; its parser and raw SAT/SAB inspection routes do not provide B-rep semantic evidence.

plan_changes: For FreeCAD qualification, pin the converter explicitly to the tested libdxfrw-built dwg2dxf and disable automatic fallback to ODA/QCAD.
Capture converter exit status and stdout/stderr independently because the current FreeCAD wrapper accepts an existing output file without checking the exit code.
Validate the emitted DXF artifact itself (nonempty, recognized version/encoding, strict structural parse, hash) before scoring FreeCAD import.
Pin C++ versus legacy Python DXF importer and record backend-specific entity disposition and importer statistics.
Keep ACIS/SAB semantic qualification separate from stock FreeCAD DXF consumption and retain exact peer artifact/version/direction boundaries.
